name: g_soundStreamPcmReader
comment: PCM audio stream reader context pointer in .bss checked before sample rate calculation and de-interleaving.
evidence: Loaded via literal 0x0054BB04 at 0x0054BA84 in Sound_Stream_CalculateByteRate; verifies reader status at +0x24 before buffer processing.

name: g_csndHardwareState
comment: CSND audio hardware state flag word in .bss updated during audio driver initialization and wave buffer configuration.
evidence: Referenced via literals 0x0010C810 and 0x0010C834 in Snd_InitSystemState and Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferMain.

name: g_irUserSessionHandle
comment: IPC service session handle in .bss for the CTR Infrared (ir:USER) service, acquired in maybe_Snd_SetupChannelBuffer.
evidence: Referenced via literal 0x001223AC alongside 'ir:USER' string (0x00754FC0) in maybe_Snd_SetupChannelBuffer, and at 0x00122AB4 in Fs_ReadRecordBlock.
